style: Create one cinematic contact sheet, EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal 16:9 frames with thin straight central gutters. Four distinct film stills in top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right order. Detailed realistic Tamil Shaivite devotional cinema, authentic South Indian granite temple architecture, natural film light, spatial depth, believable people and hands, no text, logos, labels or collage within a frame. Keep bottom corners free of foreground ritual props; lamps, incense and logo will be composited later. No permanent lightning bolts, no rain streaks baked into artwork. Dry interiors.
